text_block_list.text:
The one who prevailed in the dead heat at 
the Shuka Sho was Vodka, who showed an 
extraordinary burst of hidden strength and 
shook off Daiwa Scarlet!

Even in defeat, Daiwa Scarlet remains 
undaunted, declaring she will polish her 
weapons and prove she can beat Vodka.

Then, she tells Vodka that she will run in 
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup before heading 
to the Arima Kinen, and takes her leave.

Feeling like she wasn't moving forward as 
resolutely as someone working hard toward 
a clear goal... Vodka set her sights on 
the Arima Kinen.
